pass18_verified_scene_connections.consequence: Iroh's former military habits can create overreach; Mina's paid shift, actual ventilation design and safety decisions remain hers to contest.
The polycule's agreements require distinct consent and time to respond. A loose kite anchor closes the affected festival section until stewards permit use.
Neri safeguards traveler memory privacy while dock repair costs and workers' schedules cannot be erased by Maui's strength.
Danse documents risks and technical limits; he doesn't assume that military maintenance skills qualify him to repair every kind of object.
Records and letters may be preserved without public disclosure. The rightful recipient controls publication, and transport closures require honest official notices.
Greg gives polyamory a considered response and must verify actual stage bookings, fuel and equipment. A technician can remove a failed cable from service.
